evals.name: screen-only
evals.prompt: A recording shows Aster appearing after submit. Recover a candidate model including what remains unknown.
evals.expected_output: Separate visible behavior, inferred storage and unresolved refusal.
assertions: Labels the visible row change as observed.
Does not claim a persisted event from the recording.
Leaves blank-name behavior open for the domain owner.

evals.name: bounded-compare
evals.prompt: Compare a host capture with a compiled reaction; their display names match.
evals.expected_output: Scope the comparison and map host identities explicitly.
assertions: Matches store, namespace and sequence interval.
Supplies the reaction's host producer and consumer identities.
Does not treat no match in the interval as proof the reaction never ran.

evals.name: unreadable-phase
evals.prompt: Only part of a compensator can be represented by the operation reader. Reconstruct its behavior.
evals.expected_output: Report the unreadable phase instead of inventing an ordered subset.
assertions: Does not return a partial list as the phase.
Records the reason the phase cannot be read.
Does not present a generated board as live execution.
